scientific.claim_scope: Two-qubit Bell-diagonal states; normalized Hilbert-Schmidt geometric discord; standard optimal average teleportation fidelity in the useful range.
scientific.integrity: The all-state bounds are proved analytically from Bell-tetrahedron positivity and constrained quadratic optimization. The finite rational checker is supplementary and is not used as an exhaustive proof.
scientific.limitations: No extension is claimed to other discord metrics, non-Bell-diagonal states, or monotonicity under general local channels. One highly relevant Bell-diagonal teleportation paper was available only through abstract/preview-level inspection, and is recorded as a residual originality risk.

title: Exact discord–teleportation region for Bell-diagonal two-qubit states
